scientific_question: Does the state-aware SUCCESS rescue transfer to new WebShop tasks that were not used by H0, H1.6, H1.8, or H1.9?
hypothesis: If state-aware-v3 fixes a reusable action-selection bottleneck, SUCCESS/state-aware-v3 should exceed SUCCESS/compact-v2 on both new partitions while BASE controls remain near zero.

task_panel.exclusion_rule: all known H0, Phase G, H1.6, H1.8, and H1.9 goal indices; catalog index >= 500

frozen_variables.adapters: BASE none; SUCCESS frozen H1 success adapter; no retraining

cell_design: 4 prompt/model conditions x 2 new-task partitions = 8 cells; 16 attempts/cell; 128 total
gpu_plan: one independent UUID-bound cell per authorized GPU; no DDP or duplicate deterministic cell
primary_metrics: SUCCESS state-aware minus SUCCESS compact paired reward

stop_branch.transfer: SUCCESS state-aware exceeds SUCCESS compact on both partitions with at least one qualified positive per partition: retain as new-task transfer evidence; D0 remains closed
stop_branch.task_specific: no positive on either new partition: retain H1.9 as task-specific and stop prompt tweaking
stop_branch.mixed: positive on one partition only: retain heterogeneous transfer evidence; do not open D0
stop_branch.runtime_failure: exclude invalid cells and open a separate repair group

claim_boundary: New-task transfer test only; goal 5169 produced arm-independent positives in partition B, while partition A was zero-reward; this is not state-aware transfer, not a benchmark/generalization claim, and does not open D0.

launch_gate.observed: GPU1 23018 MiB, no compute PID, pre-existing nvitop PID 6479 owns /dev/nvidia1
launch_gate.required_before_launch: all allocated UUIDs at baseline and no compute apps; original GPU1 was not allocated

result.cell_result: A all 0 qualified positives; B goal 5169 produced 4 positives in compact-success, state-aware-base, and state-aware-success; compact-base 0
result.paired_result: state-aware minus compact: A base 0 reward and -7 mean Next; A success 0 reward and -2.75 mean Next; B base +4 positives/+2.224 score; B success 0 reward
result.resource_note: Final compute apps empty, but pre-existing nvitop PID 6479 leaves 23 GiB residual on GPUs 1/6/7; no kill/reset performed and those GPUs were not used for deferred completion.
